title: Preparation of SLiCE Extract
author: N.J. Hillson
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6vbhe2n
materials: CelLytic TM B Cell Lysis Reagent
Acquire CelLytic TM B Cell Lysis Reagent (Sigma, B7435).

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Media
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary antibiotic stocks and growth media.

substeps.instruction: Prepare chloramphenicol and streptomycin stocks to produce LB agar plates (10 μg/mL streptomycin, 12.5 μg/mL chloramphenicol), 1 L of 2X YT media (10 μg/mL streptomycin), and LB (10 μg/mL streptomycin, 12.5 μg/mL chloramphenicol).
Prepare L-(+)-arabinose (Sigma, A3256) for induction at 0.2% (weight/volume) in 50 mL.
Prepare 1 L of 2X YT media: 16 g Bacto-tryptone, 10 g Bacto-yeast extract, 5 g NaCl, adjust pH to 7.2 using 1 M NaOH or 1 M KOH, and bring to 1 L with dH2O.
Autoclave to sterilize, cool, and add streptomycin to a final concentration of 10 μg/mL under sterile conditions. Store at 4°C.

steps.title: Initial Culture Growth
steps.instruction: Streak and inoculate the PPY strain to begin culture expansion.

substeps.instruction: Streak PPY glycerol stock or fresh culture on an LB agar plate (10 μg/mL streptomycin and 12.5 μg/mL chloramphenicol) and incubate at 37°C overnight.
Inoculate 1 colony into a 50 mL tube containing 25 mL 2X YT with 10 μg/mL streptomycin.
Incubate at 37°C with heavy shaking (~338 rpm) overnight.

steps.title: Measure OD600 of Overnight Culture
steps.instruction: Determine the optical density of the overnight culture using a spectrophotometer.

substeps.instruction: Use extra media as a blank.
Ensure culture is evenly mixed and take samples under aseptic conditions.
Dilute sample ~1/10 with media to ensure the reading is within the photometric linear range (~0.1-1.0).
Calculate the final OD600 of the culture.

steps.title: Scale Up Culture to Target OD
steps.instruction: Dilute the culture and grow to a specific density before induction.

substeps.instruction: Using a sterile baffled flask (250 mL or greater), dilute the overnight culture to 0.03 OD600 using 2X YT media with 10 μg/mL streptomycin.
Shake at 37°C at ~338 rpm until the culture reaches an OD600 of 5-5.5.

steps.title: Induce Protein Expression
steps.instruction: Induce the expression of λ prophage protein Red using arabinose.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.2% L-(+)-arabinose to the culture.
Continue shaking at 37°C at ~338 rpm for 2 hours.
Measure the final OD600.

steps.title: Harvest and Wash Cells
steps.instruction: Collect the induced cells and remove media components.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the remaining ~48 mL of culture into two 50 mL centrifuge tubes.
Pellet by centrifugation at 5,000 x g for 20 minutes at 4°C and decant/aspirate the supernatant.
Wash each pellet with 50 mL ddH2O.
Pellet again by centrifugation at 5,000 x g for 20 minutes at 4°C and decant/aspirate the supernatant.
Measure the wet weight of each pellet.

steps.title: Lyse Cells
steps.instruction: Perform chemical lysis of the cell pellets.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend each cell pellet (~0.25 g each) in 300 μL CelLytic™ B Cell Lysis Reagent (Sigma, B7435).
Briefly vortex and spin down.
Transfer resuspended cells into a low-binding 1.5 mL tube and incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Clarify Extract
steps.instruction: Separate the soluble protein extract from cell debris.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge cell lysates at 20,000 x g for 2 minutes at room temperature.
Carefully transfer the supernatants into a single 1.5 mL tube, avoiding the cell debris pellet.

steps.title: Aliquot and Store Extract
steps.instruction: Stabilize the extract with glycerol and store at low temperatures.

substeps.instruction: Mix the cell extract with an equal volume of 100% glycerol.
Dispense into 40-60 μL aliquots in low-binding 0.5 mL tubes and label as PPY SLiCE extract.
Store at -20°C for <2 months or at -80°C for long-term storage (aliquots can be thawed on wet ice and refrozen up to 10 times).

steps.title: Prepare Glycerol Stock
steps.instruction: Create a long-term storage stock of the PPY strain.

substeps.instruction: Inoculate 1 single colony of the PPY strain from an LB agar plate (10 μg/mL streptomycin and 12.5 μg/mL chloramphenicol) into 5 mL LB (10 μg/mL streptomycin and 12.5 μg/mL chloramphenicol).
Incubate at 37°C at 200-338 rpm overnight.
In a sterile tube, mix equal volumes of PPY culture and 20% autoclaved glycerol.
Store at -80°C.
